verdict.rationale: AngelList Equity lets companies and recipients legally sign grants in-platform without another e-signature tool, and signing automatically updates the cap table (angellist-docs-31). Stakeholders accept and acknowledge issued instruments by e-signature (angellist-docs-17), administrators can bulk e-sign (angellist-docs-25), and share securities are generated automatically on transfers (angellist-docs-11). The update FAQ points customers toward migrating to J.P. Morgan or Pulley, which raises doubts about the product's continued availability (angellist-docs-2). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of share 'certificates' as such, an explicit permanent link between each certificate and its cap table entry, independent or hands-on corroboration, and clarity on whether the product will remain available.
